title: What If You Jumped on the Moon?

scenes.text: What if you jumped on the Moon? You would float for about four seconds.
The Moon's gravity is only about one-sixth of Earth's.
On paper, a 60 centimeter jump here becomes about three and a half meters there.
That is higher than a basketball hoop, and you would hang in the air for around four seconds.
In real life, a bulky spacesuit and slippery footing held the Apollo astronauts to a bouncy skip.
Only twelve people have ever walked on the Moon, so almost nobody has felt it.

description:
What if you jumped on the Moon?
With one-sixth of Earth's gravity, an average jump would carry you about three and a half meters up for around four seconds.
